newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sees cellular bid terms out this week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sees cellular bid terms out this week.

text.p: Bid specifications for the upcoming privatization of Brazil's Band B cellular services will be published this week, said an official at the Communications Ministry on Monday.

The rules will be subject to public hearings for 15 days, said Renato Navarro Guerreiro, Communications Ministry's executive secretary, during the inauguration of Motorola's first Latin American cellular phone plant in Sao Paulo state.
Guerreiro said contracts for private-sector Band B concessions are expected to be signed in the first quarter of 1997, with private investors operating the concessions at the end of next year.
He also said he expects Brazil to have 10 million cellular phones in 1999 and 17-18 million cellular phones by year 2,003.
Currently, Brazil has two million cellular phones, he said.
